answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.767, close to the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82) and far from quantized or fine-tuned. Top-1 agreement is 0.867, sequence agreement 0.312 and KL 0.360, all at the system-prompted extreme. The layer-2 spike of 61.9 is the strongest signal, since quantized and fine-tuned models stay below about 6.1. The activation profile also matches: onset layer 8, layer-16 L2 of 0.473 held as a plateau to layer 32 (0.493), cosine 0.855, effective rank 2.75, direction consistency 0.537. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the first-divergence position, the spike size and the plateau shape. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and activation differences.
